title: Graphic Editor Flyweight
instructions: In `config/model.py` complete `GraphicIntrinsicState` (image, width, height, colour, type) and `GraphicExtrinsicState` (x, y, intrinsic_state). In `config/registry.py` implement `FlyweightRegistryImpl` so it keeps shared intrinsic states in a dict named `_flyweights`, keyed by `GraphicType`, and returns the same object back. Do not change `GraphicType`, `Image` or `Graphic`.

evidence.label: GraphicIntrinsicState holds exactly the shared fields
GraphicExtrinsicState holds x, y and a reference to the intrinsic state
The original Graphic class is untouched
The registry returns the very same flyweight object (identity)
An unknown graphic type returns None
Storage is a dict named _flyweights keyed by GraphicType
Adding the same type again replaces the entry
Each registry has its own storage
Many placements share one intrinsic state and one image
